'''Dalsa flowers''' were a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. They had thorns, and were often used as decorations, as well as in [[vor'shandi]] face markings.
